title: Decision Matrix
hook: Going with your gut on a big decision usually means going with whatever's loudest that day.
statement: Use clear, weighted criteria for big, messy decisions.
explainer: Your gut lets price, excitement, or fear take over in the moment. A matrix makes you decide what matters most before the options start pulling at you.
sop: List every option you're seriously considering.
Pick the 4 to 6 factors that matter and give each a Weight.
Give every option a Rating on every factor.
Multiply Weight × Rating and total each option's Score.
If the winner clashes with your gut, figure out why.
equation_example: Weight × Rating per factor. A: 3 × 8 = 24. B: 2 × 5 = 10. C: 1 × 9 = 9. Total: 24 + 10 + 9 = 43. Higher means it fits your real priorities. Lower means it looks good but misses them.
question: Pick one big decision you're stuck on and write the 4 factors that really matter.
closing_statement: A weighted score catches what your gut misses.
caption:
